candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes 'Epidermolysis bullosa pruriginosa' (EBP) based on the clinical presentation (pruritic, lichenified papules/plaques, milia, erosions) and genetic findings (COL7A1 variant). Candidate C001 correctly identifies Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa and the COL7A1 variant, which is the underlying cause of EBP, but it omits the specific 'pruriginosa' subtype, which is a key clinical characteristic in this case.

The clinical record provides sufficient detail to diagnose Epidermolysis Bullosa Pruriginosa, a specific subtype of Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa, with a confirmed COL7A1 variant. Candidate C002 is a very broad category ('Inherited Epidermolysis Bullosa') and lacks the specificity of the clinical presentation and genetic findings.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Missing the specific subtype (Dystrophic) and the pruriginosa variant, as well as the genetic cause (COL7A1 variant).
